About us

Zakion Energy Pvt. Ltd.

Zakion Energy Pvt. Ltd., founded in 2015, is a team of passionate social entrepreneurs and engineering professionals dedicated to driving a sustainable future through innovative renewable energy solutions. With headquarters in Cochin and a branch in Palakkad, we specialize in Solar EPC, energy engineering, and eMobility infrastructure, delivering high-quality, efficient, and customer-focused services.

Photovoltaic solutions

On-grid, off-grid, hybrid, and solar lighting.

Energy Engineering

Energy audits, thermography, water/air audits.

eMobility Infrastructure

EV charging for residential, commercial, and public spaces.

Vision

To drive global sustainability by providing innovative, accessible, and efficient renewable energy solutions, empowering individuals and businesses to embrace eco-friendly practices and reduce their carbon footprint.

Mission

To be a leading force in renewable energy, creating a greener planet by enabling clean, affordable energy for everyone, and pioneering advancements in sustainable technology.

Values

Zakion Energy is driven by teamwork, quality, and customer satisfaction. Guided by honesty, integrity, and innovation, we deliver reliable solutions that prioritize sustainability and exceed expectations.

Photovoltaic (PV) solutions convert sunlight into clean, renewable electricity, making them a cornerstone of sustainable energy. Zakion Energy offers cutting-edge PV systems tailored for residential, commercial, and industrial needs. Whether it’s on-grid, off-grid, or hybrid solutions, our photovoltaic systems provide reliable energy, reduce electricity costs, and contribute to a greener planet. With smart energy management and aesthetically integrated solar designs, we make transitioning to solar power seamless and efficient.

ON GRID SYSTEM

HYBRID SYSTEM

In Hybrid system, both grid and battery is involved. Systems that are already connected to the electricity grid can start taking advantage of battery storage as well.

OFF GRID SYSTEM

In an off-grid system there is no public electricity grid. Once solar power is used by the appliances in your property, any excess power will be sent to your battery bank.

SOLAR LIGHTING

Photovoltaic
Solutions

Photovoltaic (PV) solutions convert sunlight into clean, renewable electricity, making them a cornerstone of sustainable energy. Zakion Energy offers cutting-edge PV systems tailored for residential, commercial, and industrial needs. Whether it’s on-grid, off-grid, or hybrid solutions, our photovoltaic systems provide reliable energy, reduce electricity costs, and contribute to a greener planet. With smart energy management and aesthetically integrated solar designs, we make transitioning to solar power seamless and efficient.

ON GRID SYSTEM

In On Grid System, the electricity generated by solar is used by the property. If a grid connected system is producing more power than the consumption,

HYBRID SYSTEM

In Hybrid system, both grid and battery is involved. Systems that are already connected to the electricity grid can start taking advantage of battery storage as well.

OFF GRID SYSTEM

In an off-grid system there is no public electricity grid. Once solar power is used by the appliances in your property, any excess power will be sent to your battery bank.

SOLAR LIGHTING

The lamp operates on electricity from batteries, charged through the use of solar photovoltaic panel. solar street lights with in-built lithium ion batteries are perfect for maximum efficiency.
